clauses.reason: The preamble paragraph states the authority and purpose (to facilitate the work of the Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy) and orders that Executive Order 12964 is amended as the next scope states; it is the operative lead-in of the one amendment. Terminated by express revocation. Section 3 of Executive Order 13062, signed September 29, 1997, ends its lead-in with "have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:"; item (b) reads "Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and". Section 7 reads "Sec. 7. This order shall be effective September 30, 1997.", so the end is dated 1997-09-30, the stated effective date. The item names Executive Order 12987 itself among the amending orders of the order it revokes.  Disclosed reading: the amendment was made when signed, 1996-01-31; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments its effect continues in the parent until the parent ends, which is the date given.

The amending text inserts the words "up to 20" in place of the number 15 in the second sentence of section 1(a), and inserts "December 31, 1996," (with the word about before it) in place of the date before February 1, 1996 in the first sentence of section 2(a), of Executive Order 12964. Terminated by express revocation. Section 3 of Executive Order 13062, signed September 29, 1997, ends its lead-in with "have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:"; item (b) reads "Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and". Section 7 reads "Sec. 7. This order shall be effective September 30, 1997.", so the end is dated 1997-09-30, the stated effective date. The item names Executive Order 12987 itself among the amending orders of the order it revokes.  Later event: Executive Order 13032, signed 1996-12-26, deletes the date December 31, 1996 that this order inserted and inserts February 28, 1997; the report date changed again, a deadline and not an end. Disclosed reading: the amendment was made when signed, 1996-01-31; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments its effect continues in the parent until the parent ends.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 12987 (61 FR 4205, PDF page 1 of the 1996-02-02 issue; sha256 0f4ba1ac...), headed Executive Order 12987 of January 31, 1996, Amendment to Executive Order No. 12964, matching the census register row (1996-01-31). Text and inventory: two scopes cover the preamble and the amending clauses (i) and (ii); I confirm the inventory. Ending: the order only amends Executive Order 12964, whose end is its revocation by Executive Order 13062 section 3(b) effective September 30, 1997 (section 7); that item names Executive Order 12987 among the amending orders revoked. The amendment was made when signed; the changed membership cap and report date live in the parent until the parent ends (reading of the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 13062 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy, which this order amends,: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
